title: Graduate Research School Scholarships (UQGRSS)

compensation.value: Living stipend of $39,220 per annum tax free (2026 rate), indexed annually; Single OSHC; tuition fees

about: UQ's Graduate Research School Scholarships fund PhD and MPhil study. Round 1 (2027) closes 25 January 2027, with outcomes from 6 April 2027, for commencement in Research Quarters 3-4 2027 or Research Quarter 1 2028. Applicants submit an expression of interest first.
requirements: Expression of interest first, to confirm a supervisor will support the research; final application if invited
Round 1 (2027) intake: Research Quarters 3 and 4 2027 and Research Quarter 1 2028

upskill.name: AI for Research & Academic Productivity
why: "Expression of interest first, to confirm a supervisor will support the research" → "Use AI to support literature exploration, academic reading, information organization, research planning, and knowledge synthesis."

"PhD / MPhil" research study → "Summarize and compare scholarly materials while identifying recurring themes, methodological differences, arguments, findings, limitations, and potential research gaps."

card_alt: EduCut Connect card for the Graduate Research School Scholarships (UQGRSS) at The University of Queensland, Brisbane, Australia, with a Round 1 deadline of 25 Jan 2027. The photo shows the Sydney Opera House and Sydney Harbour Bridge at dusk, in Sydney rather than Brisbane.
